name: Insane Scribbles
summary: In Darkshore, cultists carry Insane Scribbles torn from the Twilight Tome, a fragment of dark literature. The dancing script and warped designs unsettle the mind. Ancient forest protectors study the pages to learn the Twilight's Hammer's purpose.

sections.title: A Maddening Manuscript
sections.body: The Twilight Tome can put a mortal's sanity at risk. Its script writhes across the parchment, and graceful scrollwork warps into grotesque images before the reader's eyes. Even one torn sheet, called Insane Scribbles, leaves its bearer lightheaded and disoriented. The writing makes little sense, yet the parchment hums with primal, deeply ancient magic tied to dark powers buried beneath Azeroth.

sections.title: Clues for the Ancients
sections.body: Onu, the ancient who presides over the Grove of the Ancients, studies the scribbles for signs of what blights Darkshore. Onu recognizes the chaotic energy clinging to the parchment as the work of the Old Gods. So the defenders of Kalimdor seek to piece the scribbles together and learn why the Twilight's Hammer has gathered along the mist-shrouded shores.

faq.q: What happens if you try to read these scribbles?
faq.answer: The text resists easy translation. As you look at the parchment, its letters swim and the designs around them twist into horrifying shapes. Soon, dizziness and mental exhaustion set in as you try to decipher them.

faq.q: Where were these scribbles torn from?
faq.answer: The scribbles were torn from the Twilight Tome, a foul grimoire kept by Twilight's Hammer cultists operating in Darkshore.

faq.q: Who can understand or study the scribbles?
faq.answer: Onu, the Ancient of Lore, examines the recovered parchment. Drawing on centuries of knowledge, Onu senses the ancient, primal magic binding the ink and seeks to learn the cult's purpose in the region.

faq.q: What kind of power radiates from the parchment?
aliases: what magic is in the scribbles
faq.answer: The parchment pulses with chaotic, primal magic tied to the Old Gods, the dark deities worshipped by the Twilight's Hammer.

angles.text: As a priest, you may recognize the twisting script as a perilous assault of madness, set against the Light's clarity.
As a night elf, you know relics of the Twilight's Hammer threaten Darkshore's ancient peace and sacred lands.
